summary: Add three static checks to UrlValidator.validateTargetUrl; nothing else changes.

decisions.title: Static checks only
decisions.rationale: No network calls and no external services, as assumed during clarification.

decisions.title: Reject only clear-cut cases
decisions.rationale: Credentials in the URL, IP-literal hosts and local-only hosts have no legitimate use for a public shortener. Anything fuzzier would risk false rejections.

decisions.title: Leave the rate limiter alone
decisions.rationale: Out of scope after review; it is shared by every create request.

intendedFiles.purpose: Reject credentials, IP literals and local hosts
Tests for the new URL checks

risks: A false rejection blocks a legitimate link; only unambiguous cases are rejected
